verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail has a security page, but it documents only account-level protections: authenticator-app 2FA [10, 16] and the option to have mail shipped unopened rather than scanned [9]. It says nothing about how mail is physically secured or how scans are protected. Missing for 10: facility/physical security controls, staff background screening, encryption of scans at rest and in transit, and any independent corroboration.
